summary: Full backend + frontend regression for the Buntooz Matchmaker pivot. Wrote a fresh pytest suite covering auth, catalog, stats, deleted-legacy-endpoints, request/quote/accept flow, contact-reveal masking, uploads (accept/reject/traversal/large/auth), role gating, admin verify toggle, provider profile, and brute-force lockout — 37/37 passed. Playwright walked the landing page, 4-step /post wizard, customer dashboard, provider lead board (masked), provider profile tab, admin console tiles + cards, and mobile 390px viewport for landing and /post. No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: No authentication on GET is intentional (so tags work) but the handler blocks '..' and '/' only after URL decoding — traversal attempts like %2F..%2Fserver.py currently return 404 rather than the explicit 400 the spec describes. Behaviour is safe (file resolves under UPLOAD_DIR only), just wording of the test/spec.
File size is checked AFTER fully reading into memory (await file.read() then len>8MB). Works fine for MVP but a malicious 500MB upload would still be buffered. Consider streaming/spool limit.
Pydantic returns 422 for price<=0 and short message (spec loosely says 400). Not a real bug — 422 is the correct FastAPI validation code.

issues: Type-option grid needs a brief moment to render after api load; consider a skeleton so the wizard body is not visually empty between navigation and API resolve.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~680-line file mixing models, auth, routes and seed. Fine for MVP but recommend splitting into routers/, models.py, deps.py, seed.py before adding more categories.

Brute-force lockout is keyed on email only (not IP). An attacker can trivially lock out any known account for 15 minutes — consider combining with IP or resetting counter on successful login-from-different-ip.
Provider `skills` seeds hard-coded to ['house-cleaning'] on registration. Once more categories go live this must be picked in the register form or provider profile.
Upload size check reads whole payload first — add a max_upload_size middleware or stream check for safety.
close_request does not restrict to open requests — a matched request could be force-closed by owner; acceptable behaviour but consider explicit rule.
No pagination on /api/leads, /api/requests, /api/provider/quotes — hard limits (200-500) present but no cursor; fine for MVP.
test_credentials: admin@buntooz.com/Admin@123, customer@buntooz.com/Customer@123, pro@buntooz.com/Pro@123 — all working; brute-force lockouts cleared before run.
seed_data_creation: Playwright and pytest created a handful of TEST_* users (customers + unverified providers) and several requests/quotes on customer@buntooz.com. The lead board still shows the one live open request seeded from smoke-test; matched request from smoke-test remains. Consider running db.users.deleteMany({email:/^TEST_/}) periodically.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file is /app/backend/tests/test_buntooz_matchmaker.py — reuse it as regression. Run `mongosh test_database --eval 'db.login_attempts.deleteMany({})'` if any auth tests get 429s. Frontend uses data-testids exactly as documented in the review request; login uses login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-btn (NOT plain type='submit'). Mobile /post first step shows type-option-<slug> buttons — wait for them explicitly, not just post-steps.
